title: Nvidia: from a Denny's diner to $5 trillion

scenes.say: Okay? What just happened? Nvidia just lost its founder, so let's see how a company that started in a diner got this big.
Nineteen ninety three. Three friends plan a graphics chip company in a Denny's diner in San Jose. You can't make this up.
Then the late nineties. Their graphics cards help make video games look amazing, so gamers fall in love.
But here's the twist. Those same chips turned out to be perfect for AI. So when the AI boom hit, everyone needed Nvidia.
At its peak, it was worth nearly five trillion dollars. And now the man who built it has resigned. So from a diner to that, and everyone's asking,
